_comment: WP-G3B served config of f_bwd (PREREGISTRATION_BWD.md 0 / 3.1-3.5 / B0.2 / B1): CP1 form F5b-1+jmax at f0_bwd 1600 MHz x the two-term clock input (s_bwd 0.664) + the S4-bwd ring layer read from the timed variants (S4-bwd served (PB B5 (iii)-(iv) + B5.1 + B6): W0 per class (timed comm_only, as read); glue class-direct on the comm traces (prep + B4.1 helpers on the ACTIVE tokens + accumulate per dKV MiB + memset + copy; helpers follow the clock, the rest clock-independent); X = x0 + kappa sum W0 from the exposed exchange on the comm traces (H1 holds); pre served; kernel entries under the structural law (lambda 0.575713246335817) at the CP group's median attention-phase clock; kernel scale 0.9108045229938406); kernel entry per the served model's u_treatment (none: none = PB B7, tile + k0 + b_S q_phys + tau rho n_chain + static(n), no U subtraction; subtracted_in_fit = run 7; inside_k0 = F5b(step) - O_graph_bwd(P_q)); ring prep mode class_direct (PB B7 (ii) decided on the 108 walls); every 3.5 alternative is a named setting scored alongside, never selected on sealed rows

clock_input.amendment: PREREGISTRATION_BWD.md 3.3 / B0.2 (two-term law served from the first freeze; alpha 1 and 0.76 frozen alternatives) / CD A25
clock_input.f_crit_rule: min over the CP group's ranks of the heater-phase SM clock telemetry mean (clock card f_crit; A19.1 (i))
clock_input.rule: served = O_graph_bwd + (F5b_f0 - O_graph_bwd) x [s f0 / f + 1 - s] at cp = 1; at cp > 1 every step's kernel entry x [s f0 / f_crit + 1 - s]; glue / exchange / pre unscaled
clock_input.two_term_s_source: hardware profile clock.two_term_s_bwd (B1.1 (report 01b, 2026-10-06): least squares on the log ratios of the 96 kernel-level NOCOMM flash_bprop pairs of probe B1 (hsg 7756270, llama3_70b-p4096-cp4, arm a duty 19 ~1465 MHz vs arm d light ~1938 MHz per rank, same kernel / rank / backward step); s_bwd = 0.664 +- 0.015 at f0_bwd = 1600 MHz; comm + nocomm 0.724; LS alpha 0.65 (reader alpha_kernel 0.764); one d128 cell, one clock lever - the d256 reading is open (no light nsys arm on qwen3_5_397b 16K))

helper_terms.rule: PB B4 as written (frozen alternative 'per_headdim_token'): H per head_dim token form; the form was fitted on wall_norm - H; CP1BwdModel.kernel() adds H back; the helper classes follow the two-term clock law

helper_variants.rule: PB B4.1: served H variant decided by the per-unit table (cp1_bwd_selection.json helper_variant_decision); the other variant and the no-helper fit are frozen alternatives

kernel_law.formula: k(f) = tile f0/f + (1 - lambda) C f0/f + lambda C; tile = tau x chain tiles (+ tau_jmax J_max), C = k0 + b_S S + tau rho n_chain + static(n) (U excluded)

clock.note: PB B6: the ring block's law pre-splits every kernel entry (structural: tile + (1 - lambda) C scaled under alpha 1, lambda C unscaled); the split's clock_law_override carries it; this block applies to blocks without a law

s4bwd.text: S4-bwd served (PB B5 (iii)-(iv) + B5.1 + B6): W0 per class (timed comm_only, as read); glue class-direct on the comm traces (prep + B4.1 helpers on the ACTIVE tokens + accumulate per dKV MiB + memset + copy; helpers follow the clock, the rest clock-independent); X = x0 + kappa sum W0 from the exposed exchange on the comm traces (H1 holds); pre served; kernel entries under the structural law (lambda 0.575713246335817) at the CP group's median attention-phase clock; kernel scale 0.9108045229938406

ring.H1: H1 HOLDS: X served as x0 + kappa sum W0 (no remainder)
ring.H2: H2 FAILS: traced glue vs timed G outside 10 % on the short or the long packs (class median)

selection.mode: no candidate passes every unit: the one passing the most units (15 / 18); the failing units are known limits

u_treatment.rule: PB B7 (i): the CP1 form fitted on wall_norm - H, static only, NO U / O_graph subtraction (k0 positive; the CP1 non-helper glue lives in k0 + b_S S); the run-7 U-subtracted structure is the frozen alternative cp1_u_subtracted

variants.name: crit
variants.text: the critical-rank accounting: wall = pre + max_rank sum_i (k'_i + g_i) + X (PB section 0)
